title: Removing Boundary Smoothness from the Hot-Spots Conclusion in the Simple-Eigenvalue Case
summary: We give a reduction from a smooth-domain theorem excluding interior critical points of first positive Neumann eigenfunctions to a non-strict hot-spots conclusion on arbitrary bounded simply connected planar domains with compact Neumann resolvent and simple first positive eigenvalue. The main analytic step is spectral convergence under exhaustion by conformal images of concentric disks. A reflection extension, conformal invariance of Dirichlet energy, and compactness of the Sobolev embedding give a direct proof.
